# 2026-11-01 hardware transcript (sanitised)

Console: retail Switch 2, firmware 23.0.1, Seedsow Lullaby Demo 1.0.0.
Upstream: `alula/switch-artemis-launcher` @ `b9e6de82934dfda1f2c6219aaf305ed980a3d1ba`.
Host: macOS, node 25.2.1, python3. Console address is written as `$CONSOLE`
(the real value was a private LAN address). Account uid is not recorded.

`save9999.dat` was rebuilt from the backup (caret retargeted at
`save:/inject.iet`, container v1003 kept), not taken from upstream.

## 6. HTTP server (button Y)

```
[D] socket initialize -> 0x0
[D] socket fd=0
HTTP server listening on http://CONSOLE_IP:8080
```

```
$ curl -s -i http://$CONSOLE:8080/status
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 117
Connection: close

nora2hax/seedsow HTTP server
POST /eval body=<lua>
PUT|POST /save?path=<name> body=<file>
DELETE /delete?path=<name>
```

```
$ curl -s -X POST http://$CONSOLE:8080/eval -d 'print("hello world")'
status: ok
output:
hello world

$ curl -s -X POST http://$CONSOLE:8080/eval --data-binary 'print(_G.n2h.platform)'
status: ok
output:
Ounce
```

## 7. Save write/delete (uniquely named disposable file)

```
$ printf 'ns2-artemis-probe-...' > /tmp/artemis-probe-20261101.bin
$ curl -s -X PUT --data-binary @/tmp/artemis-probe-20261101.bin \
    'http://$CONSOLE:8080/save?path=save:/artemis-probe-20261101.bin'
wrote 51 bytes to save:/artemis-probe-20261101.bin

$ curl -s -X POST http://$CONSOLE:8080/eval --data-binary \
    'local f=io.open("save:/artemis-probe-20261101.bin","rb") ...'
status: ok
output:
51
ns2-artemis-probe-20261101T2103Z-payload-0123456789
EXISTS

$ curl -s -X DELETE 'http://$CONSOLE:8080/delete?path=save:/artemis-probe-20261101.bin'
deleted save:/artemis-probe-20261101.bin

$ ... confirm ...
GONE
```

## 8. Persistence

- HOME -> X -> A (close software), relaunch -> launcher screen again.
- fingerbot force-off (16 s) + boot press, navigate, launch -> launcher screen again.
- minus at the launcher menu -> `[!] RECOVERY MODE (ignoring script updates)`.
- minus held continuously through the resume, with an `inject2.lua` that writes
  `save:/inject2-ran.txt`: `inject2-ran.txt` was **present** after boot both
  times. The startup update bypass did not trigger; no hardware restore was run.

## 9. Second HTTP validation — 2026-11-01 22:32 (no RPC session)

The installed launcher was booted from the existing save; button Y started the
server. No RPC session was involved. Console address is written as `$CONSOLE`.

```
GET /status                          -> 200, nora2hax/seedsow banner
POST /eval print("hello world")      -> status: ok / output: hello world
POST /eval print(_VERSION)           -> Lua 5.1
POST /eval print(_G.n2h.platform)    -> Ounce
POST /eval io/os/debug/loadstring    -> io=true os=true debug=true loadstring=true
GET /nope                            -> 404 no such endpoint
GET /eval                            -> 405 use POST /eval
```

Uniquely named disposable file (`artemis-http-20261101-2233.bin`, 39 bytes):

```
PUT   /save?path=save:/artemis-http-20261101-2233.bin
      wrote 39 bytes to save:/artemis-http-20261101-2233.bin
read  /eval io.open("save:/...") -> 39 bytes, exact content
DEL   /delete?path=save:/artemis-http-20261101-2233.bin
      deleted save:/artemis-http-20261101-2233.bin
read  again -> GONE
```

Safety refusals:

```
PUT    /save?path=save:/core.lua    -> 400 attempted to modify protected file
DELETE /delete?path=save:/core.lua  -> 400 attempted to modify protected file
PUT    /save?path=../escape         -> 400 path escapes save:/
```

Installed-file integrity without RPC. A polynomial hash
(`h = (h*131 + byte) mod 2^32`) was computed identically by the console's Lua
and locally over the staged payload:

```
file            size    console hash   staged hash
core.lua        19156   1619833061     1619833061
exploita.lua       20   3396816408     3396816408
http.lua        10915   2751963712     2751963712
inject.iet        501   1964970987     1964970987
inject.lua       4036   1893777622     1893777622
proggy.ttf      41208    635907845      635907845
save9999.dat    28400   3714976867     3714976867
```

Relaunch: HOME -> X -> A (close software), relaunch, launcher screen again,
Y -> `GET /status` 200 and `POST /eval` -> `relaunch ok Ounce`.

## 10. Temporary test artifacts, live check — 2026-11-01 22:50

Booted the installed launcher and started the HTTP server (Y), then queried the
save directly. This is a current check, not the earlier delete log:

```
POST /eval
  inject2.lua ABSENT
  inject2-ran.txt ABSENT
  core.lua true
  http status Ounce
```

So the recovery-test update files are not present in the save, and the launcher
core is.
